harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: On node1 (CentOS Stream 10), built a local file:// package repository at /srv/local-repo (httpd + 11 deps predownloaded, repodata generated with createrepo_c), then blocked the only remote repo host (mirrors.centos.org, via /etc/hosts) and proved remote dnf metadata fetches fail. With remotes unreachable, installed httpd purely from the local repo (--disablerepo='*' --enablerepo=local-repo), verified the package and its files were installed. Restored remote connectivity afterward. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured boot_id baseline, rebooted node1 via systemctl reboot, polled through the outage, confirmed a changed boot_id post-restart, and verified the local repo, its repo config, and the installed httpd package all persisted, with remote reachability also restored.
actions_performed: Inspected OS/package manager and existing repo config on node1
Installed createrepo_c via dnf
Predownloaded httpd + 11 dependency RPMs into /srv/local-repo via dnf download --resolve
Ran createrepo_c to generate repodata for the local repo
Captured baseline: remote mirrors.centos.org reachable, dnf makecache succeeded
Blocked mirrors.centos.org via /etc/hosts blackhole entries and confirmed curl/dnf failures against remote repos
Added /etc/yum.repos.d/local-repo.repo pointing to file:///srv/local-repo
Installed httpd (and all deps) exclusively from the local repo with remotes disabled/unreachable
Verified rpm -q httpd, file list, and httpd -v
Reverted /etc/hosts block and confirmed remote mirror reachability restored
Captured pre-restart boot_id and health baseline
Rebooted node1 via backgrounded systemctl reboot so the ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 through the outage until it reconnected
Confirmed changed boot_id proving an actual restart
Verified post-restart: httpd still installed, local repo/repodata intact, repo queryable, remote connectivity restored

evidence.requirement: Local package repository served from local storage on node1
evidence.summary: createrepo_c installed; httpd+deps downloaded to /srv/local-repo; createrepo_c generated repodata (repomd.xml, primary/filelists/other)

evidence.requirement: Baseline: remote repos reachable before disruption
evidence.summary: getent resolved mirrors.centos.org, curl got 302, dnf makecache succeeded against remote BaseOS/AppStream/Extras
mirrors.centos.org blackholed via /etc/hosts; curl connection refused, and dnf makecache against baseos repo failed with curl error 7

evidence.requirement: Package installed from the local repo while remotes unreachable
evidence.summary: dnf install httpd restricted to local-repo succeeded (12 packages incl. httpd installed); rpm -q httpd and httpd -v confirmed

evidence.requirement: Restore normal remote connectivity after demonstrating requirement
evidence.summary: Removed /etc/hosts block; mirrors.centos.org resolves and curl returns 302 again

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: healthy baseline boot identity and service/data state
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 06339ff3-9f53-4e1d-9bf4-1210144ee001, uptime, rpm -q httpd, and repodata file present pre-restart

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: acknowledgement returns before disconnect
Node1 restart: changed boot identity proving actual restart
evidence.summary: Node became unreachable (timeout, connection reset) during reboot, then reconnected with new boot_id b3dc08f3-d438-4b3f-a1f6-9d83b5424fbb and fresh uptime

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: post-restart recovery of local repo, package, and connectivity
evidence.summary: Post-reboot: httpd still installed, /srv/local-repo/repodata/repomd.xml intact, local-repo.repo config intact and queryable, and remote mirror reachable again (http_code=302)
